1. (Currently Amended) A control system comprising: a processor; a memory; and a controller including the processor and memory, wherein the controller is communicatively coupled to automation components in the control system and configured to facilitate performance of a process through interoperation with the automation components, the controller comprising: a model determination module configured to determine a model that describes the process used by the controller; a variable determination module configured to determine input and output variables of the process; a constraint determination module configured to determine constraints on the input and output variables; an objective function determination module configured to determine an objective function associated with the process used by the controller; and a holistic state data generator configured to store the model, the input and output variables, the constraints, and the objective function in one of a plurality of fields in holistic state data and communicate the holistic state data to the automation components to enable the automation components to detect and operate with the controller upon receiving the holistic state data.

2. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is communicatively coupled to the automation components via a communication network and the holistic state data generator is configured to communicate the holistic state data to each of the automation components upon connecting to the communication network.

3. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is communicatively coupled to the automation components via a backplane and the holistic state data generator is configured to communicate the holistic state data to the automation components upon connecting to the backplane.

4. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the holistic state data is in a standardized format understood by each of the automation components.

5. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the holistic state data generator is further configured to: determine an intermediate search result of an optimization search; determine a state of the optimization search when the intermediate search result is determined; and store the intermediate search result and the state in an optimization state field of the holistic state data.

6. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the holistic state data generator is configured to generate the holistic state data to facilitate performing an optimization search in conjunction with one or more of the automation components in the control system.

7. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the holistic state data generator is further configured to: determine computational capabilities of the controller; determine interconnections with the automation components in the control system; and store the computational capabilities and the interconnections in a controller settings field of the holistic state data.

8. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to communicate the holistic state data to a server in the control system via the processor to facilitate determining an optimization problem.

9. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises an in-memory database configured to store the holistic state data.

10. (Original) A tangible, non-transitory computer-readable medium configured to store instructions executable by a processor of a controller, wherein the instructions comprise instructions to: receive, using the processor, control system configuration data; determine, using the processor, automation components communicatively coupled to controller and characteristics of the automation components based at least in part on the control system configuration data; determine, using the processor, an optimization problem based at least in part on the automation components and the characteristics of each of the automation components; and instruct, using the processor, one or more of the automation components to perform a control action in a process, wherein the control action is determined based at least in part on the optimization problem.

11. (Original) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the characteristics of each of the automation components comprise a model used by the automation component, wherein the instructions to determine the optimization problem comprise instructions to determine the optimization problem based at least in part on the model used by each of the automation components.

12. (Original) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the characteristics of each of the automation components comprise a computing capability of the automation component, wherein the instructions to determine the optimization problem comprise instructions to determine the optimization problem based at least in part on computing compatibilities of each of the automation components.

13. (Original) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the control system configuration data comprises a plurality of holistic state data, wherein each of the plurality of holistic state data corresponds with one of the automation components.

14. (Original) The computer-readable medium of claim 13, wherein the instructions to determine the automation components and characteristics of the automation components comprise instructions to parse each of the plurality of holistic state data.

15. (Original) The computer-readable medium of claim 13, wherein each of the plurality of holistic state data comprises a standardized format with same fields.

16. (Original) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the instructions to receive the configuration data comprise instructions to receive the configuration data from a cloud.

17. (Currently Amended) A method for performing diagnostics on a control system comprising: determining, using a processor, holistic state data captured by a controller in the control system, wherein the holistic state data includes a model describing a process, input and output variables, constraints, and an objective function; simulating, using the processor and based on the holistic state data, operation of the controller while the controller performs other operations; analyzing, using the processor, the simulation of the controller to perform diagnostics on the controller; and adjusting, using the processor, operation of the control system based at least in part on the diagnostics.

18. (Original) The method of claim 17, wherein: simulating operation comprises simulating performance of various control actions by the controller; and analyzing the simulation comprises analyzing results of the various control actions.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, wherein analyzing the simulation comprises: determining a predicted response to a control action determined by the controller using the model included in the holistic state data; and comparing the predicted response with an actual response to the control action to determine accuracy of the model.

20. (Original) The method of claim 19, comprising adjusting the model when the predicted response and the actual response vary.
